gold: Lightning-induced retinopathy with delayed-onset cystoid macular abnormalities

selector.rationale: The patient was struck by lightning, which directly supports the champion diagnosis, and the development of cataract and maculopathy is consistent with the expected effects of a lightning strike.

rejected.label: Traumatic Cataract
rejected.why: The cause is more specific to lightning than general trauma

rejected.label: Optic Neuropathy
rejected.why: Pupils were symmetric, with no relative afferent pupillary defect, contradicting optic neuropathy

rejected.why: While possible, the specific findings of cataract and maculopathy point more directly to the champion diagnosis
